What “covering a year” means here

Digital practice

Named families cover the main mathematical topics, including construction tools for clocks, shapes, points and charts.

Independent recall

Broad successful practice over later days helps distinguish a familiar answer from a fact that has been recalled after a gap.

Practical and reasoning work

A grown-up observes physical measuring, model making, explanation and other practical activities. The digital game cannot verify these alone.

A finite question bank cannot contain every possible curriculum question. The year pages expose the practice families and their focuses so teachers and parents can judge how they fit their teaching. Schools can arrange topics differently within the key stages.

England’s statutory mathematics programme

One UK label does not mean one UK curriculum

The year-by-year map used here follows England’s programme. Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland use their own arrangements. Learners elsewhere can use the exercises as supporting practice without treating the academy year as a formal curriculum judgement.
